name: To Train A Killer: Cerule's Story
source:
Are serial killers born or made?  As we explore the story of Cerule's first kill, when his life with his mother was shattered when she met an abusive man, find an answer to that question.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/to-train-a-killer-cerules-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
连环杀手是天生的还是后天养成的？当我们探索塞鲁尔第一次杀人的故事时，当他的母亲遇到一个虐待男人时，他和母亲的生活被打破了，找到这个问题的答案。

[来自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/to-train-a-killer-cerules-story]itch.io[/url]]
